recipe.visualDefinition: A trio of men in formal black attire posed in a moody, industrial studio setting featuring visible stage lights, wireframe scaffolding, and a textured grey backdrop, overlaid with bold, geometric serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Three subjects arranged in a staggered, depth-focused line
Visible overhead stage lights creating dramatic top-down highlights
Contrast between dark formal wear and a neutral, textured studio environment
Graphic elements in red and white anchoring the bottom right corner
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and soft focus
Industrial studio props like wire scaffolds

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three full-body figures occupying the left and center-right, scaled to fill the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large typographic block in the bottom right corner acts as the primary weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye enters at the faces of the subjects, follows the line of their bodies down to the graphic text and the red arc.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial dark space at the bottom and textured space between the subjects and the studio ceiling.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Charcoal grey and black (background and clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the lighting; the red accent provides the only high-chroma element.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The numeral '7' features a curved, droplet-style terminal on the descender
The letter 'f' has a long, elegant crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A high-contrast serif paired with a large, stylized numeral and geometric shapes (arc and bar).
graphicDevices: Large red circular arc framing the numeral

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high x-height and bracketed serifs of the era.
Provides the necessary contrast and elegant teardrop terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A grainy film photograph of three men in black suits standing in a dark studio. The background has wireframe grids and visible stage spotlights at the top. The lighting is warm and directional.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the word 'after' in lowercase red serif font at the bottom right. Place a large white '7' to its right. Underline 'after' with a white bar. Add a red arc starting from the top of the '7' curving towards the right edge.

verificationChecks: Is the film grain visible and authentic to the late 80s?
Does the red arc correctly frame the numeral?
Are the stage lights at the top creating realistic lens flare?
Is the typography lowercase and high-contrast serif?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red color is vibrant against the dark background
Check that the subjects' poses feel coordinated but natural
Verify the '7' has a distinct, elegant curve
Confirm the background props do not distract from the subjects
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + industrial props + dramatic top-lighting + high-contrast serif typography + geometric red accents.
